# Crown Safe Editing Instructions

This repository is controlled by Crown guardrails.

For wizard work:
- stay inside the 50-wizard scope unless explicitly authorized
- prefer audit, inventory, and proof artifacts before implementation edits
- never create a new wizard pattern if a canonical registry/pattern exists
- never create shadow student, school, tenant, role, billing, or enrollment truth
- never bypass tenant/RBAC/audit requirements
- never report PASS without generated evidence

When uncertain, stop and create a blocker note instead of guessing.
